About this item

  • REMOVE 100% MORE PLAQUE - The Oral B Electric Toothbrush features soft crisscross bristles that are gentle on your gums while effectively removing up to 100% more plaque compared to a regular manual toothbrush. Enjoy a thorough and gentle clean every time.
  • DENTIST INSPIRED ROUND BRUSH HEAD reaches areas where rectangular brush heads don't. Experience elevated oral care from the WORLD'S NO. 1 DENTIST RECOMMENDED BRAND
  • 3 BRUSHING MODES - The Oral B Electric Toothbrush offers three modes, ensuring a customized clean for every individual. Whether you need daily cleaning, sensitive mode, whitening, this toothbrush has a setting that meets your specific dental needs.
  • 2 YEAR WARRANTY by Oral-B - This brush comes with a 2-year warranty by Oral-B, providing you with peace of mind and assurance of our product's durability and high standards.
  • WORLD'S NO. 1 DENTIST RECOMMENDED BRAND: Count on the unmatched quality and reliability of the world's leading dentist-recommended brand. Our replacement brush heads are endorsed by dentists globally and ensure your optimal oral health.
  • DENTIST INSPIRED ICONIC ROUND BRUSH HEAD combines with gentle micro-vibrations gives you a surprisingly enjoyable experience and healthy teeth and gums for life
  • ORAL-B ORIGINAL REPLACEMENT HEAD: Experience the perfect fit, seamless functionality and 10X better cleaning performance than non-branded refills, COMPATIBLE with Oral-B iO series
  • TUFT-IN-TUFT BRISTLE TECHNOLOGY - Benefit from advanced Tuft-in-Tuft bristle technology, designed to penetrate deeper between teeth and along the gumline, removing more plaque and providing a superior clean compared to traditional bristle configurations.

About this Item

  • REMOVE 100% MORE PLAQUE - The Oral B Electric Toothbrush features soft crisscross bristles that are gentle on your gums while effectively removing up to 100% more plaque compared to a regular manual toothbrush. Enjoy a thorough and gentle clean every time.
  • DENTIST INSPIRED ROUND BRUSH HEAD reaches areas where rectangular brush heads don't. Experience elevated oral care from the WORLD'S NO. 1 DENTIST RECOMMENDED BRAND
  • 3 BRUSHING MODES - The Oral B Electric Toothbrush offers three modes, ensuring a customized clean for every individual. Whether you need daily cleaning, sensitive mode, whitening, this toothbrush has a setting that meets your specific dental needs.
  • 2 YEAR WARRANTY by Oral-B - This brush comes with a 2-year warranty by Oral-B, providing you with peace of mind and assurance of our product's durability and high standards.
  • WORLD'S NO. 1 DENTIST RECOMMENDED BRAND: Count on the unmatched quality and reliability of the world's leading dentist-recommended brand. Our replacement brush heads are endorsed by dentists globally and ensure your optimal oral health.
  • DENTIST INSPIRED ICONIC ROUND BRUSH HEAD combines with gentle micro-vibrations gives you a surprisingly enjoyable experience and healthy teeth and gums for life
  • ORAL-B ORIGINAL REPLACEMENT HEAD: Experience the perfect fit, seamless functionality and 10X better cleaning performance than non-branded refills, COMPATIBLE with Oral-B iO series
  • TUFT-IN-TUFT BRISTLE TECHNOLOGY - Benefit from advanced Tuft-in-Tuft bristle technology, designed to penetrate deeper between teeth and along the gumline, removing more plaque and providing a superior clean compared to traditional bristle configurations.
